review_method: Visual review of cropped BDD traffic-sign annotations; proposals were not accepted automatically
class_definition: Front-facing red octagonal stop signs, including legible STOP text and clear raised-hand stop signs; warning-symbol and no-entry signs excluded
other_candidate_policy: Exclude unverified images rather than turning uncertain signs into negative labels
limitations: Model-assisted candidate selection can miss stop signs
Small or occluded signs require further review
Bounding boxes inherit the source annotation policy
